description: On-demand, source-grounded architecture context for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Use compact, freshness-labelled canonical context only when it narrows a coding investigation. One observed workflow used 25% less input context and 43% fewer distinct file-token reads; it is not a universal benchmark.
